<!--
  A sidebar section heading with optional right actions. Set `expanded` and it becomes a disclosure button
  (aria-expanded, the toggle event).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import { variants } from "../utils";

  /** SectionHead: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const sectionHeadVariants = variants({
    base: "flex items-center justify-between pr-4 pl-4",
    variants: {
      size: {
        default: "h-8 py-2 text-xs font-semibold",
        lg: "h-12 py-2 text-sm font-bold",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { size: "default" },
  });

  export type SectionHeadProps = {
    size?: "default" | "lg";
    expanded?: boolean;
    controls?: string;
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    right?: Snippet;
    ontoggle?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    size = "default",
    expanded,
    controls,
    class: className,
    children,
    right,
    ontoggle,
  }: SectionHeadProps = $props();
  const cls = $derived(
    cn(
      sectionHeadVariants({ size: size }),
      "rounded text-foreground in-data-[nav=collapsed]:hidden",
      className,
    )
  );
</script>

{#if (expanded != null)}
  <ButtonPlain
    type="button"
    class={cn(cls, "w-full text-left")}
    aria-expanded={expanded}
    aria-controls={controls}
    data-slot="section-head"
    data-expanded={expanded}
    onclick={() => ontoggle?.()}
  >
    <Inline data-slot="section-head-title">
      {@render children?.()}
    </Inline>
    {#if right}
      <Inline class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="section-head-right">
        {@render right?.()}
      </Inline>
    {/if}
  </ButtonPlain>
{:else}
  <Box class={cls} data-slot="section-head">
    <Inline data-slot="section-head-title">
      {@render children?.()}
    </Inline>
    {#if right}
      <Inline class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="section-head-right">
        {@render right?.()}
      </Inline>
    {/if}
  </Box>
{/if}
